notes: Tier+Tactical Tier 2 on Tier 1's ammo system. The Assault Rifle's first round after half a second's pause is its truer one, as Kai's lastShotTime check picks; the Battle Rifle and Magnum check a lastShotTime they never set, so in Kai's code they always fire their steady round, and do here. The Light MG fires a second, free and tighter round each cycle (onFire2) and slows its gunner to LMGArmor while firing (Support_AltDatablock), which lifts as it stops, runs dry or leaves the hand. Jet with the Combat Shotgun in hand fires its double blast (Support_ImageAltTrigger): two shells, 16 pellets and 4 blasts, then the shotgun comes back. Battle Rifle and LMG rounds slow whoever they hit; Magnum headshots. The Military Sniper's hitscan head hits crit (three times the damage, its own kill message, Emote_Critical's burst and sounds) only while Emote_Critical is on, as Support_TT_Raycasting checked isObject(CritProjectile). The LMG's slowed body is a player type in the host rules. The Scoped Magnum is one of Kai's easter eggs, loaded only with the hidden "???" setting (off by default): it is imported hidden.
